s.note: chant optional, the crowd outside the bank
s.how: Cook 2 thinly sliced brown onions in 2 tbsp oil over low heat for 40 minutes until deep brown, then cool. Stir into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt. Serve with 300g ridged potato chips.

s.note: sent in to feed the hostages behind the counter
s.how: Split 2 long hero rolls lengthwise. Layer 150g ham, 100g salami and 100g sliced provolone, then shredded iceberg and sliced tomato. Dress with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper. Press down firmly, then cut each hero into 6 wedges.

m.note: delivered to the door, the delivery kid becomes a star
m.how: Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Season 400g crushed tomatoes with salt and 1 tsp dried oregano. Stretch the bases thin, spread with sauce, top with 250g grated low-moisture mozzarella and 100g pepperoni, and bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 minutes.

w.how: Simmer 200g caster sugar with 500ml water and the zest of 2 lemons for 5 minutes, then cool. Stir in 250ml lemon juice, about 6 lemons. Freeze in a shallow tray, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy. Serve in paper cups.

d.n: Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt
d.note: for the cops sweating on the barricade outside the bank
d.how: Mix 1 tbsp flaky salt with half a tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime on a plate. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 chilled glasses and dip in the chilli salt. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each glass, add 2 ice cubes, then pour in a cold 375ml bottle of lager slowly.
